text: Assumption: Modifying parallel accesses to the same vector instance are not thread-safe without external synchronization — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Modifying parallel accesses to the same vector instance are not thread-safe without external synchronization — is this correct?
norm: modifying parallel accesses to the same vector instance are not thread safe without external synchronization
assumption: Modifying parallel accesses to the same vector instance are not thread-safe without external synchronization.
rationale: The specification refers to [vector], but does not define an independent reentrancy or concurrency guarantee for modifying operations.
